title: Northbeam TechWorks Parts Pool Standard: Sourcing, Markup and Hold Figures
content:
The parts pool serving Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair works to figures fixed per TechWorks service: the markup on the parts cost when parts are billed, the business days a stocked part ordinarily takes to reach the service point, the calendar days a job may be held waiting for parts before it is escalated, where parts are sourced from, the deposit taken before a special-order part is bought as a percentage of the part price, and the calendar days on site after which the job goes to the depot instead.

| TechWorks service | Parts markup, percent | Stocked part arrives in, business days | A job may be held for, calendar days | Sourced from | Special-order deposit, percent of the part price | Goes to the depot after, calendar days |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TechWorks In Store Bench Service | 25 | 3 | 21 | manufacturer or the retailer's own stock | 50 | 0 |
| TechWorks Standard Home Installation | 25 | 3 | 21 | manufacturer or the retailer's own stock | 50 | 14 |
| TechWorks Home Theatre Calibration | 30 | 5 | 30 | manufacturer only, to protect the calibration | 100 | 21 |
| TechWorks Appliance Install and Haul Away | 20 | 5 | 30 | manufacturer or an approved equivalent | 50 | 21 |
| TechWorks Business On Site Deployment | 15 | 2 | 14 | manufacturer or an approved equivalent | 0 | 10 |
| TechWorks Managed IT Care Annual | 10 | 1 | 7 | the retailer's spares pool first, manufacturer second | 0 | 5 |

### Notes on the figures

- The markup falls as the service rises, from 30 percent on a calibration and 25 percent at the counter and on a standard home installation down to 10 percent on the annual care service.
- The calibration service is the one TechWorks service sourcing from the manufacturer only, and the one taking a special-order deposit of 100 percent of the part price. The business deployment service and the annual care service take no deposit at all, their figure standing at 0.
- The days a job may be held run from 7 on the annual care service to 30 on the calibration and appliance services.
- A bench job carries no depot escalation, its figure standing at 0 calendar days; the other five run from 5 days on the annual care service to 21 on the calibration and appliance services.
